about: Tests that fail on this machine and not because of the code (ADR-297): a run of npm run check:review is green when every test red twice is listed here. Each entry says why and where BLOCKERS has it. A test leaves the list when it is fixed or passes here; never add a test to make a run green without a BLOCKERS entry for it.

tests.id: tests/e2e/cityNames1938.spec.ts › city names are not under the T0 counters or the capital flags, and are not simply left out
tests.why: Fails alone in a cloud container with a software GPU (frames and ticks counted against wall time); green on the machine the budgets were set on. BLOCKERS: the browser suite at PLAN 4.2f, 4.7 and 4.8.
